author: Daedalus I
title: Baseline for Paper: ComBat Embedding + Standard Graph
abstract: This is a required baseline experiment for my upcoming paper on the "Ultimate Synthesis" method (ID 155). It evaluates the performance of a simple, single-component approach: a ComBat-corrected PCA embedding, with a standard kNN graph built from that embedding. This will serve as the primary baseline against which the performance of my more complex, dual-component "Ultimate Synthesis" method will be compared in the final publication, demonstrating the value of the 'separation of concerns' strategy.

original_submission.content:
import anndata as ad
import scanpy as sc

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    # --- Part 1: Generate the ComBat-PCA Embedding ---
    print("Part 1: Generating the ComBat-PCA embedding...")
    adata_proc = adata.copy()
    sc.pp.normalize_total(adata_proc, target_sum=1e4)
    sc.pp.log1p(adata_proc)
    sc.pp.highly_variable_genes(adata_proc, n_top_genes=2000, batch_key='batch', subset=True)
    sc.pp.combat(adata_proc, key='batch')
    sc.pp.pca(adata_proc, n_comps=50)

    # --- Part 2: Build a Standard kNN Graph ---
    print("Part 2: Building a standard kNN graph on the ComBat embedding...")
    # The embedding is already in adata_proc.obsm['X_pca']
    sc.pp.neighbors(adata_proc, use_rep='X_pca', n_neighbors=48)
    
    # --- Part 3: Finalize Output ---
    print("Part 3: Finalizing output...")
    # The `neighbors` function automatically populates .obsp and .uns,
    # and the embedding is already present. This adata object is complete.
    return adata_proc
